# Icon sources

Technology logos are sourced from [Skill Icons](https://github.com/tandpfun/skill-icons), copyright (c) 2022 tandpfun, under the accompanying MIT license.

The SVGs in this directory are the source artwork. `assets/tech-stack.svg` and `assets/tech-stack-mobile.svg` embed this artwork with resized viewports and unique internal IDs. Technology names and trademarks belong to their respective owners.
